about.en: ASELSAN Elektronik Sanayi ve Ticaret A.S. is a Turkish defence electronics manufacturer founded in 1975 and headquartered in Ankara, majority-owned by the Turkish Armed Forces Foundation. It develops military communications, radar and electronic warfare, electro-optics, avionics and command-and-control systems. ASELS represents its common shares listed on Borsa Istanbul in Turkish lira, and derivative markets quote the same equity under the ASELS ticker, converted from TRY to USD.
